identity.methodology: Fresh worker per clip; actual browser decode, MoveNet CPU/WASM and JS GRU; 30Hz; no cached predictions. Current preprocessing reorder included. Runtime is descriptive, not a controlled speed benchmark.

metrics.policy: Human unsure and no_shot are negative. No forehand/backhand events means negative, including tracking failures. Any forehand/backhand detection counts as a positive; mixed positives cannot pass as negative. Clip labels only; no detection/contact timing checks.

rescoring.reason: User requested merging unsure and no shot; forehand/backhand are the only positives. Original inference and frozen human labels preserved.
